name: 巅峰对决
scope: Every collectible species with raw BST at least 600 remains eligible. Exactly these additional species use authored elite-only loadouts. Stable facility ID elite and uniform six-species sampling without replacement are preserved. Ordinary random encounters and original boss records are unchanged.
basis: The user approved the V45 twelve-species non-multi-hit shortlist and three conditional support specialists after source and engine review. Bafro 177 and Brook 110 were explicitly excluded. See design/notes/elite-candidates-v45.md and tools/verification/elite-sub600-audit.mjs for the prior review, not a claim of exhaustive competitive ranking. The user subsequently approved species 599 specifically as a self-sacrifice support that grants the next entrant speed and accuracy, and authorized further period research and role-based additions. Five more species are selected from 2011-2012 matchup discussions. This is the currently implemented baseline; engraving-dependent candidates remain in the design review pending the user's separately collected sources.

additions.name: 杰西卡
additions.role: 穿透削血·连击先制强攻
additions.selectionReason: Period attack/HP set: flat-damage pressure, genuine effect-31 three-to-five-hit priority, attack setup and a fighting finisher. Skill 11078 has independent source multi-hit evidence and is not an inferred AtkNum-only operation.

originalPoolSkillPolicy: Only elite automatic loadouts exclude fixed multi_hit operations lacking original seer_effects 31 evidence. Genuine effect-31 multi-hit skills remain eligible. Ordinary random loadouts and catalog skill data are unchanged. An eligible four-move set is required; no fallback reintroduces excluded moves.
